summary: Backend regression testing after email/config refactor (send_confirmation_email now supports Resend/Emergent-proxy/skip; emergentintegrations removed from requirements.txt). Wrote a dedicated regression suite (test_regression_email_refactor.py) covering: registration with no RESEND_API_KEY (Emergent proxy path), 15 seeded runners present, timing reset clearing finish times per-distance, reset-all clearing everything, and results grouping/sorting. Full backend suite (backend_test.py + test_timing.py + new regression file) = 25/25 PASS when run serially. When run under the pytest.ini-default xdist parallel workers there is ONE flaky failure caused by cross-test data collision between the new reset-all test and the pre-existing test_results_sorted (both mutate the same registrations collection) - this is a test-harness parallelism issue, NOT a product regression; serial run is clean. DB left in the requested clean state: 15 seeded bibs 1-15, all finish_time/finish_seconds null, all timing start_times null. Backend logs confirm Emergent proxy /api/v1/email/send returns 202 Accepted and registration continues even if it failed (best-effort).

minor.issue: pytest.ini enables xdist by default (-n auto --dist loadscope). New reset-all test can race with test_results_sorted when run in parallel because both mutate the shared registrations collection. Consider adding @pytest.mark.serial or scoping mutating tests to a single worker.

action_items: None functional. Optional: mark heavy-mutation tests (reset-all, results ordering) as serial in pytest.ini to prevent parallel-run flakiness.
critical_code_review_comments: send_confirmation_email correctly branches Resend -> Emergent proxy -> warn-and-skip, wrapped in try/except so email failures never surface as HTTP errors from POST /api/registrations. Verified via live 202 responses in backend logs.
startup() seeds/updates admin idempotently using bcrypt; login field is a plain string ('admin') not an email despite Pydantic model naming it 'email' - works but naming is misleading.
reset endpoints clear both timing.start_time and finish_time/finish_seconds on the affected distance(s) as expected.
results endpoint correctly filters finish_seconds != None, groups by distance, sorts ascending and assigns rank.
Minor: LoginRequest.email is 'str' (not EmailStr) which is correct for the plain 'admin' username - fine but the field name is misleading.
test_credentials: admin / bergslagenadmin (login field: 'email' but accepts plain 'admin')
seed_data_creation: None - regression suite uses pre-seeded bibs 1-15 and creates only one TEST_ registration that it cleans up immediately.
context_for_next_testing_agent: pytest.ini uses xdist parallel by default. If you add mutating tests on the registrations/timing collections, either run pytest with '-o addopts=' for serial, or coordinate seeded-bib usage to avoid races. Emergent email proxy is live at https://integrations.emergentagent.com/api/v1/email/send using EMERGENT_EMAIL_KEY from backend/.env; RESEND_API_KEY is intentionally unset.
